entries.title: Psalms 149:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Sing unto Jehovah a new song; [sing] his praise in the congregation of the godly.

entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their King.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: Let them praise his name in the dance; let them sing psalms unto him with the tambour and harp.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people; he beautifieth the meek with salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Let the godly exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: ¶Let the high praises of *God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand:

entries.title: Psalms 149:7
segments: To execute vengeance against the nations, [and] punishment among the peoples;

entries.title: Psalms 149:8
segments: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments: To execute upon them the judgment written. This honour have all his saints. Hallelujah!
